# enom Provider

Provider for managing eNom domain resources via the reseller API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) eNom API base URL. Defaults to https://reseller.enom.com/interface.asp.
- `pw` (String, Sensitive) eNom reseller password. Can also be set via ENOM_PW environment variable.
- `uid` (String) eNom reseller username. Can also be set via ENOM_UID environment variable.
